The '''Deathly Heat''' was a region in the northern [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], it was inhabited by a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] militia.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Deathly Heat was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
